title: The whole check: every check, once per round
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0011 no longer matches the current design.
decision: The whole check runs every stage of the project's one deterministic check without stopping at the first failure; each failing run is followed by one round that fixes everything it revealed, then one more run. No stage evaluates agent behaviour or calls a model (0142, 0154).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
